description: Upload artwork to locate thin ink strokes, narrow gaps and small isolated elements using PrintCheck's physical print limits. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.06 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. 4–512 pixels per side and up to 1 MB. Non-interlaced PNG or JPEG. Use alpha for transparent artwork or an explicit RGB background for opaque artwork.
name: prepare_printcheck_raster
title: PrintCheck Small Details from Image — prepare request
